description: Land Acquisition - Harakgalegama, Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Panaliya, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for taking possession of described land parcels, including detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena), the core content focuses exclusively on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
